De inschrijver is verplicht voor elk daarvan een volledig bod in te dienen. Het ontbreken van een van beide maakt het bod onvolledig. De gemeente behoudt zich het recht voor de opdracht te gunnen aan de oplossing van haar keuze op basis van de algemene prijs-kwaliteitsanalyse. Opties Vrije opties worden niet toegelaten. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Ameti juhised on toodud käesolevas Lepingus ja Raamlepingus, seejuures Ametil on õigus anda täiendavaid juhiseid. Kui Teenuseosutaja arvates rikub Ameti poolt punkti 3.2 kohaselt antud juhis Andmekaitse õigusakte, teavitab Teenuseosutaja sellest Ametit viivitamatult. Kui Teenuseosutaja kasutab Teenuse osutamiseks Alltöötlejat ja edastab talle Isikuandmeid, mille suhtes Amet on Vastutav töötleja, peab Teenuseosutaja tagama, et need Alltöötlejad täidavad Lepingu tingimusi nii, et Töötlemine vastaks Lepingu ja Andmekaitse õigusaktide nõuetele.
